item.title: Some of my projects
item.description:
This is a small (incomplete) list of projects that I have started over the years and that have had some impact on me in one way or another. Starting with my very first successful C project that allowed transfer of files between a famous gateway router (fli4l) and a local machine, flicp.

You can find most of my projects on Github or by clicking on them below.

1-2-animation

This command line tool generates Poemotion images. These are 2D images that provide an optical illusion of being 3D when viewed with a striped masked.
